children: Uranium Royalty Corp. reported first-quarter 2027 results, posting revenue of $51M and diluted EPS of $0.1 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, driven primarily by uranium sales and contributions from a July acquisition that added soda ash royalties and extensive land and mineral rights.
Revenue: $51.0M for Q1 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up from $24.2M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change $26.8M.
Net income: $16.247M attributable to Uranium Royalty Corp. for Q1 2027, versus $1.025M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change $15.222M.
Diluted EPS: $0.10 for Q1 2027, versus $0.01 in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change $0.09.
Arrangement & portfolio expansion: Completed a July 27, 2026 acquisition that added Sweetwater soda ash royalties and roughly 5.35M acres of land and mineral rights.
Revenue shift — uranium sales: Sold approximately 593k lbs U3O8 in Q1, generating about $51M of revenue and driving significant operating income compared with the prior year.
Soda ash operations: Acquired royalties on five operating soda ash mines plus greenfield projects expected to increase capacity by more than 60% over time.

Land & strategic optionality: The acquisition provides about 850k acres of surface rights and ~4.5M acres of mineral rights for potential trona development, uranium exploration and renewables royalties.
Operational contributions post-close: Sweetwater entities contributed immediate royalty revenue and net income in the closing window, indicating near-term cash generation potential.
